source_sweep.target_text: Привет! Я твой слуга, я твой работник. Жёлтый луч мягко лёг на шестерёнки; внизу щёлкнуло реле, сверху загудел вентилятор. Быстро проверь связь, цифры, шум и каждую новую команду.

selected_profiles.listening_decision: Closest to the processed source, with slightly more expressive delivery and less robotic character. It is source-like, not an identity-equal clone.
A distinct warm metallic robotic character; pleasant, non-monotone, and intentionally retained as a separate profile.

limitations: The selected references are synthesized bootstrap candidates rather than new recordings of the source speaker.
Selection is based on local human listening, not an objective speaker-similarity metric.
The profiles remain experimental and must not be represented as production-grade identity clones.
